title: Linearity of Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f,g:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates. The Fourier coefficient of $f-g$ at $S$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ minus that of $g$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
